results.bound: W[1]\text{-hard with respect to }\beta\text{ to distinguish between at most }\beta\text{ and at least }F(\beta)\cdot\beta\text{ blocking pairs, for any computable }F:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}
results.quote: Theorem 1. Let \(F:\mathbb{N}\rightarrow\mathbb{N}\) be an arbitrary computable function. Given an instance \((\mathcal{P},k,\beta)\) of Min-BP-SMI-dec it is W[1]-hard to distinguish between the following two cases: (i) \(\mathcal{P}\) admits a size-k matching with at most \(\beta\) blocking pairs. (ii) Every size-at-least k matching of \(\mathcal{P}\) has at least \(F(\beta)\cdot\beta\) blocking pairs.

results.bound: W[1]\text{-hard with respect to }\beta\text{ to distinguish between at most }\beta\text{ and at least }F(\beta)\cdot\beta\text{ blocking pairs, for any computable }F:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}
results.quote: Corollary 1. Let \(F:\mathbb{N}\rightarrow\mathbb{N}\) be an arbitrary computable function. Given an instance \((\mathcal{P},k,\beta)\) of Min-BP-SRI-dec it is W[1]-hard to distinguish between the following two cases: (i) \(\mathcal{P}\) admits a k matching with at most \(\beta\) blocking pairs. (ii) Every matching of \(\mathcal{P}\) has at least \(F(\beta)\cdot\beta\) blocking pairs.
